identity_verification.method: NCBI PubMed esummary plus title/DOI/authors/year on genuine main PDF; supplement title or publisher DOI-linked inventory checked separately

coverage.main: All eight main pages 563–570, abstract, methods, results, discussion, end matter and references read from genuine PDF; page565 reread untruncated.
main_figures_visually_read: Figure1 pedigree and all four sequence traces
Figure5 cultured-cell microscopy and localization chart
Figure6 embryo microscopy, section schematic and localization chart
coverage.supplement: Complete publisher-listed jws-humu.20480.doc: all four rendered pages, Table S1 all42 rows and abbreviation key, Figure S1 and both panels of Figure S2 visually inspected, with all captions/text.

gaps: Completeness is relative to the one file listed by the current publisher supplement inventory; no universal archival-completeness claim.

source_conflicts: Abstract implies both W255G and H286R diminish neural-crest induction; Results p567 and Supplementary FigureS2B show W255G comparable to wild type, with H286R reduced. Do not inherit the abstract over the actual panel.

Results p566 leave de novo mutation in mother versus an untested nonpenetrant maternal grandfather open; discussion is more categorical. The selected sister inherited the maternal allele; do not call her variant de novo.
Pulmonary atresia (PA) and pulmonary valve atresia (PVA) are distinct labels in the supplement key. Source-supported PA does not prove a separately assessed PVA-positive or PVA-negative status.

papers.title: A novel X-linked recessive mental retardation syndrome comprising macrocephaly and ciliary dysfunction is allelic to oral-facial-digital type I syndrome.

identity_verification.method: NCBI PubMed esummary plus title/DOI/authors/year on genuine main PDF; supplement title or publisher DOI-linked inventory checked separately

coverage.main: All eight article pages171–178 including abstract, methods, results, discussion, acknowledgments and references; ProQuest page9 is a permission notice and was read but is not counted as an article page.
main_figures_visually_read: Figure2 index IV:1 photographs; no phenotype transfer to IV:11
Figure3 index IV:1 and control traces plus predicted translation; two high-resolution crops additionally inspected
Figure5 northern blot (index IV:1 versus four controls)
coverage.supplement: Publisher lists one item with a .pdf filename, but genuine content is RIFF/Cinepak AVI,640x480,128 frames at12fps,10.666667 seconds. All128 frames visually inspected in temporal order across eight4x4 contact sheets,320x240 per frame. This is complete frame coverage at reduced resolution, not timed motion playback or an independent ciliary-beat analysis.
coverage.supplement_genotype_phenotype: The acquired movie adds no genotype/individual phenotype table or selected-IV:11 trace.
coverage.underlying_data: No raw chromatograms, original high-speed capture, control movie, quantitative ciliary reanalysis or additional selected-individual measurements.
gaps: Main text says supplementary videos (plural), while current publisher inventory exposes one AVI item; a complete historical movie set is not certified.
Movie overlay says recorded128fps/play12fps; methods say camera set125fps. Timing discrepancy retained, no beat-frequency estimate made.
The movie contains no readable individual label. Attribution to index IV:1 comes from article methods, not from identifying the selected IV:11 in the video.

source_conflicts: Source text says2122–2125dupAAGA, but NM_003611.1/.2/.3 all containGAAG at2122–2125. Figure3 instead shows anAAGA duplication consistent with2123–2126. Those two mutant sequences and canonical SPDIs differ. Frozen exact nucleotide allele is NOT source-verified.
Figure3 and northern blot/ciliary experiment are index IV:1. Text explicitly reports the shared mutation in IV:11, but no individual IV:11 trace or cilia experiment is supplied.
Control count is167 in methods and168 in results; neither is silently harmonized.
Abstract says all but one affected male died in infancy; selected IV:11 is explicitly reported to die at age3. Prefer selected-case text for age.

Original paper describes a novel OFD1-associated X-linked recessive syndrome and only speculates about OFD1 in another SGBS-like linked family. Frozen OMIM300209 label is later source-store categorization, not a separately proven diagnosis in this paper.
